metadata.timing_policy: fresh sequential process; startup+parse30s default; assertions+check shared solve deadline; independent validation separate

plan.selection: Within each named family, choose syntax-eligible files with smallest SHA256(seed + newline + relative_path). No solver outcomes are used.
plan.algorithm_policy: Both combinations use the same PeriodicWordEquality certificate. No algorithm changes are planned after held-out solver results are observed.

selection_audit.exact_novelty_note: Exact file SHA256 novelty, not semantic independence.

interpretation: Both backends use the same frozen runtime and common-power certificate. This is one fixed-order trial on a syntax-eligible, hash-selected held-out sample, not a statistical speed ranking or a claim about unsupported operations. SAT witnesses are checked by the other native backend; UNSAT claims have no proof certificates. Parsing is shared. Missing counters are unavailable, not zero; wrapper counters need not expose every periodic lemma. Exact hash novelty does not imply semantic independence of instances.
